contexts.text: Combat (necessary) in order to attain the happiness of eternal life.
On the entrance of man into eternal life. General article. AC 314.
By eternal life is meant eternal happiness.
The happiness of eternal life. Signified.
In order for a man to be elevated from (these sensuous Spirits) let him think about eternal life.
He was asked whether he had ever thought about eternal life. He said he had not believed in it. Why.
All are predestinated to eternal life.
The truths which are from the Word regard and have as an end eternal life.
They who from infancy have thought but little about eternal life... yet have lived a good moral life...
The wickedness of depriving the neighbour of eternal life. Signified.
The things which have no being and manifesting with man are not appropriated to him... Thus they do not effect anything to the eternal life of man...
They shall inherit for ever = eternal life.
The life of Heaven, which is called eternal life, is not infused into anyone immediately, but mediately.
In proportion as anyone confirms himself against the eternal life of his own soul, he confirms himself against the things of Heaven and the Church.
The crown = eternal life the reward of victory. AE 358.
I have seen them... exalted into angelic wisdom, and into its happiness, which is eternal life.

Spiritual freedom is from the love of eternal life. No one comes into this love and its delight but he who thinks that evils are sins, and therefore does not will them, and at the same time looks to the Lord...
(Thus) eternal life is also eternal bliss.
That the Lord will give eternal life to those who keep and do the truths... of this Book now opened by Him. Signified.
Blessed = him who receives eternal life. References.
On eternal life, that is, the life after death, that it is the end.
Eternal life from Him. Signified.
His life in others is eternal life... His life is in the faith and love with man; and this life is eternal life.
Acknowledgement that eternal life is from the Lord. Signified.
That those who are conjoined with the Lord through love and faith receive eternal life. Illustrated.
That man has eternal life according to the uses of his affections. General article.
